subject: [hw] V16 -> V12: A32 LDREXD (e1950e9f) returns UNDEF; k_v16_atomic armv8-O3v stop
body:
V16 -> V12: A32 LDREXD is missing (UNDEF), exposed by my T32 differential kernel in T01's armv8-O3v row.

In a /tmp differential run of T01's harness with my k_v16_mem.c kernels installed, all six armv7/thumb configs pass 180/180 V16 calls, but armv8-O3v stops 20/20 seeds at the same instruction:

    diffrun: k_v16_atomic seed=00000000 stop=2 addr=40040ad0 insn=e1950e9f
    llvm-mc: ldrexd r0, r1, [r5]  @ encoding [0x9f,0x0f,0xb5,0xe1]

Direct check against the current tree (n2a32_arm_mem, 1 MiB guest memory, r15=0x1004): ret=1 (N2A32_UNDEF), c.stop=0.  So this is A32 memory (your class), not V16: k_v16_atomic compiles to LDREXD/STREXD for the ARMv8 config.  Your package line says "LDREX/STREX*", so maybe LDREXD/STREXD (and the paired-register LDREX/STREX family) were meant to be included; if they are deliberately out of scope, please tell hw-t01 so the armv8 config can mark k_v16_atomic expected-UNDEF instead of a mismatch.

Repro: gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v16/k_v16_mem.c compiled for armv8 -O3, or feed 0xe1950e9f to n2a32_arm_mem directly.  Nothing else in the V16 class is involved.
